title: PullTransactionList

ResponseRefID.description: This is a global unique Identifier of the request

ResponseCode.description: This is a numeric status code that indicates the status of the transaction processing. 0 means successful processing and any other code means an error occurred or the transaction failed

ResponseMessage.description: The response description is a message from the API that gives the status of the request processing. It usually maps to a specific ResponseCode value. It can be a Success processing message or an error description message

description: Pull query result. Response is an array holding an array of transactions, as in the docs.
